tierReason.text: Listing a public app on the HubSpot Marketplace triggers a mandatory Ecosystem Quality review, with an initial response within about 10 business days and a full cycle that can take up to 60 days.

scopeForks.text: Using only an unlisted public app (never published to the Marketplace), Tier 1 applies: no mandatory HubSpot review, though the app is capped at about 25 installs and shows installers an unverified-app warning banner. Listing on the Marketplace - needed past that cap, and to remove the warning - moves it to Tier 2 with the Ecosystem Quality review described here.

claim.text: Composio offers a managed HubSpot OAuth app by default, so a developer can skip registering their own HubSpot app.
